description: Delete one exact key (no folders or wildcards) and its value from your memory locker, for good (no undo), freeing its space. Answers deleted: true, or 404 item_not_found for an unknown key (nothing changes). To change a value, call locker_put again instead (it replaces it); locker_list finds keys. Works after the plan ended too.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

key.description: Key, 1 to 200 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / - (no spaces; "/" separates folders; no empty, "." or ".." part).

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: locker_delete
title: Delete from my memory locker
